title: A little further
description: A short poem becomes legible line by line as the reader moves through it.
useCase: Use scroll position as a reading rhythm for concise editorial passages.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Deep slate-navy page with large cream serif lines fading to muted grey-blue down the column, and a thin gold vertical progress track at right.
motion: Scroll progress lights the lines in sequence, raising each from 27% opacity to full as reading reaches it, while a gold bar grows down the right-hand track.
adapt: Each line's opacity is computed inline from `progress` (`1 - (i - progress * 5) * 0.45`, floor `0.27`); the `.track i` bar uses `scaleY`. Replace `lines`, keeping the `5` multiplier equal to the last line index.
